last.content:
Convert one piece of residue from the Java mod (namespace 'examplemod') to Bedrock.

Kind: recipe
Source: data/examplemod/recipes/steel_trim.json

The deterministic converter refused it because:
- trim addition examplemod:steel_ingot is this pack's own item, and a Bedrock add-on can't register a trim material: BDS refuses it even when it carries minecraft:trim_materials ("should be a valid trim material", BDS 1.26.52.3 content log (#272 probe, ingame runs 38936397375 and 38937251687)): not writt...

reply.content: Declined: Bedrock ignores trim_materials on a custom item, so a steel trim cannot work.
